title: Logging Pipeline Architecture
decision_quote: All production services must stream logs via OpenTelemetry OTLP over gRPC directly to the collector, bypassing stdout.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: ADR-0003 mandated standard stdout JSON logging for container runtimes.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Stdout logging docker daemon buffer saturated during Kafka replay spikes.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Reversal: All production services must stream logs via OpenTelemetry OTLP over gRPC directly to the collector, bypassing stdout.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Confirmed, documented in ADR-0007 superseding ADR-0003.

title: PostgreSQL Sharding Strategy
decision_quote: We are partitioning payment transactional ledger tables by tenant ID hash across 16 database shards.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Reviewing cluster scale projections for the next 18 months.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Decision: We are partitioning payment transactional ledger tables by tenant ID hash across 16 database shards.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Documented in docs/adr/0005-database-sharding.md.

title: Search Engine Backend Selection
decision_quote: We are migrating search/ from PostgreSQL tsvector to distributed OpenSearch to support sub-50ms fuzzy queries.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: We originally prototyped search/ using PostgreSQL tsvector full-text indices.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Reversal: We are migrating search/ from PostgreSQL tsvector to distributed OpenSearch to support sub-50ms fuzzy queries.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Assigned Issue #88 to track the cluster rollout.

title: Event Serialization Standards
decision_quote: All Kafka event producers must register Protobuf v3 schemas with strict backwards compatibility checks in CI.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Uncoordinated schema changes in billing payloads broke downstream ingestion twice this month.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Decision: All Kafka event producers must register Protobuf v3 schemas with strict backwards compatibility checks in CI.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Published ADR-0004.

title: Kubernetes Secret Provider Migration
decision_quote: Decommissioning git-crypt in favor of HashiCorp Vault with automated 30-day token rotation in Issue #120.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Previously we stored encrypted secrets directly in git using git-crypt.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Reversal: Decommissioning git-crypt in favor of HashiCorp Vault with automated 30-day token rotation in Issue #120.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: All clusters migrated successfully.

title: Internal Service-to-Service Protocol
decision_quote: All internal East-West RPC communication between microservices must use gRPC over HTTP/2 with mTLS.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Internal JSON over HTTP/1.1 is consuming excessive CPU on serialization.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Decision: All internal East-West RPC communication between microservices must use gRPC over HTTP/2 with mTLS.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Documented in ADR-0006.

title: OpenTelemetry Trace Sampling Rate
decision_quote: Setting adaptive tail-based sampling to 5% for HTTP 200 responses and 100% for error status codes in PR #198.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: 100% trace capture is overwhelming our Grafana Tempo storage.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Decision: Setting adaptive tail-based sampling to 5% for HTTP 200 responses and 100% for error status codes in PR #198.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Storage overhead dropped 80% while retaining full visibility on 5xx incidents.

title: PgBouncer vs In-App Pooling
decision_quote: Eliminating in-process connection pools in favor of a centralized PgBouncer pooler in transaction mode in PR #231.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: We previously configured in-process connection pools inside each ECS container task.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Reversal: Eliminating in-process connection pools in favor of a centralized PgBouncer pooler in transaction mode in PR #231.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Max DB connections dropped from 1,200 to 120.

title: Docker Layer Cache in CI
decision_quote: Replacing local runner directory caching with remote buildx registry inline cache in Issue #140.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Using local runner directory caching was causing cache invalidation bugs in GitHub Actions.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Reversal: Replacing local runner directory caching with remote buildx registry inline cache in Issue #140.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: CI pipeline build times dropped from 14 minutes to 3.5 minutes.

title: Continuous Performance Testing
decision_quote: We are scheduling automated nightly Locust load runs against the staging environment in PR #240.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Need automated load verification before weekly production deployments.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Decision: We are scheduling automated nightly Locust load runs against the staging environment in PR #240.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Approved and scheduled.
